# Attribution

These five files are copied unchanged from
<https://github.com/semdr-project/limassol-hotel-hvac-energyplus-dataset>
at commit `0227f2039c2e072b2f794922e63b6d0508cc2f6e`.

- Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), see `LICENSE`.
- Dataset DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19615332
- Upstream author: SEMDR Project. Cite as *Limassol Hotel HVAC EnergyPlus Simulation Dataset*.

Simulation output for a reference hotel model, not measured data. See ADR 0009.
The weather (EPW) and building (IDF) files are not vendored. Fetch them from the
upstream commit if you need them.
